g.text: Training dynamics and observed resource use
Task-specific CE: values across different target tasks are not directly comparable
All arms: fresh base + LoRA, 192 updates, accumulation 8, same 768 sources exposed twice, one seed.
Validation CE uses region targets for RR/RD and decision targets for DD. Token counts are measured; budgets differ.
